=== SCAN ===
1 min read 04 
Lead scanning app 
Set up, scan, save and recover a missed scan. 
The save rule 
Press SUBMIT after every scan. An unfinished scan is not saved. 
Set up before travelling 
Install The Event App by EventsAIR on the phone you will carry. 
Enter the event code from your sales manager and allow camera access. 
Log in with your own name and PIN; do not share credentials. 
Open Scan Leads and test the practice QR code from the organiser's setup email. 
If the event code or your PIN is missing, ask your sales manager before the event. If your pass or registration details have not arrived, tell James. 
At the stand 
Open Scan Leads and scan the visitor's badge. 
Answer the programmed questions and add a note with the visitor’s problem, project stage, agreed action and timing, and your name as the stand contact. If no action was agreed, record why in the note. Record only information the visitor agrees to share. 
Press SUBMIT before starting the next conversation. 
The app captures the contact details, answers and notes entered for each visitor. Keep the note specific enough for Peter and Eerin to assign the agreed action. 
Sales leadership to confirm 
Eerin and Peter to confirm the programmed qualifying questions before the team uses the app. 
If a scan fails 
With the visitor’s agreement, note a usable phone number or email address, organisation, problem, agreed action and timing, and your name. Hand the notes directly to Peter or Eerin that day and ask them to confirm receipt for the Zoho hand-off. If neither is on the stand, contact them by phone; keep the note secure until one confirms receipt. Flag any unresolved hand-off at the daily debrief. 
For app support, ask James for the organiser’s contact before the event if the setup email is missing; during the event, ask at the registration desk. Cameron Walsh is the stand contact for operational issues.
